lines.x: Look carefully. Sort the files by type, then deadline and prioritization. Put urgent ones on top, others behind. That's the most efficient organization method. Wait... I seem to have inadvertently done all the paperwork. This was supposed to be your job, right?

I've checked all files related to the elite operator, Blaze. There are no records of her real name, or place and date of birth. Don't tell me you don't know. Aren't you supposed to be one of the leaders here? You really have no idea? How...? What am I supposed to do here...? Ahem, I apologize for the inconvenience and distress, Doctor. I shouldn't have accused you.

You don't need to be so cautious around me. Other than the case at hand, I'll treat everything else on the ship as if it never happened. But if there is another explosion in the corridor outside my room, I'll make the perpetrator's hair stand on end for two straight weeks!

'Assume the responsibilities for the post to which you are assigned.' Doctor, as one of the leaders of Rhodes Island, it is not your duty to... Huh? My hair's standing up again? Hold on! G-Give me a moment to fix my look first! Strange, I thought I had discharged all the static electricity this morning...

Even today, I can vaguely recall the first time I saw you in Lungmen. You, Blaze, and Ch'en... are all holding onto countless secrets... and I will uncover them one by one. It's only fair to exchange secrets? Wha-What? You... No! It's t-too early for that...!

Ask me anything. Only when you speak up can I decide what is just and unjust, and whether I wish to take action. I need to take my position into consideration? This has nothing to do with that. The Censorate, Judicial Review Office, Department of Discipline and Supervision... They are nothing but institutions. Law is only proven just when enforced by man.

Rhodes Island's ideals conflict with my beliefs. However, I do recognize the necessity of agreeing to disagree while seeking common ground... So goes the necessity of providing assistance in exchange for information.

No matter where I am, the electricity flowing through my body never ceases. The thunderlight is a symbol of justice. It drives me forward, sometimes even waking me up at night... Hm? There's another complaint that I've damaged an AC unit? Nonsense! Lies and slander! I don't even need to use a remote to turn on the AC, let alone touch it!

Blaze was implicated in a major case. All evidence has been deliberately destroyed. However, there remain a few 'coincidences' surrounding persons and times. Not many, but enough to raise doubts, and enough for me to suspect connections between several different cases. This has nothing to do with you, but you should take adequate precaution. All I can do is offer you a fair warning.
You can't even properly manage your physical condition. How lax and irresponsible! Sprawling on desk like this, were you expecting me to put a blanket over you? There won't be a next time.

I've signed and obtained an investigation authorization with your company. Don't worry, this is me acting solely as an individual. You may call me Leizi, if you wish. Who am I? Have we met before? Are you serious?!
I see, this is a completely different principle from military training.
Promotion? I suppose this is how you handle career advancement? The promotion process at Rhodes Island seems to differ from that of common private companies…

I, Leizi, am the bearer of the thunderlight and the law, the vision and reach of Great Yan. My philosophy does not align with that of Rhodes Island, and I have no intention of bridging the gap between the Infected and non-Infected. However, we may now fight side by side against our enemies!
With my own eyes, I shall judge what power Rhodes Island possesses.
I can do that, yes, albeit at a price.
Heed my orders!
I have no interest in the identity of my enemy.
In place.
It may be done.
As you command.
Hark! The thunder rumbles!
O great thunderlight, strike!
No mercy for transgression! Lightning shall judge!
Pure thunder calls down justice! Shatter all falsehoods in all realms!
The essence of Lei Fa... is my will becoming one with this great land.
Well done. As my standards are quite high, you should be proud of yourself.
Not enough. You can do even better. Do not rest upon your laurels—you have the ability to strive for greater heights.
Impossible... what happened? How can this be?
Such humiliation...! Begone, you! Return and reflect! I will hold back the enemies, leave!
Where's the power socket?
How rude!
Oh... did that hurt? Please be mindful of the static electricity around me.
Arknights.

A year's planning is done in the spring—and though it may not be spring yet, do you simply plan to idly loaf around at a new year's outset? You should still sharpen yourself on holiday. As the saying goes, the man who catches fins for one day then rests for two, will find himself slothful with dust on his shoe. Hm...? Two, four, six, eight... Hey! If you keep slacking I'll have finished annotating these documents myself!
Work dutifully, Doctor.

Ahem. Judicial Review Office Censor Leizi expresses good wishes on the Dr.{@nickname}'s birthday. May your life be ever warm as spring, and of peace and prosperity... Heeeey, I'm being serious here! Don't laugh!

With the mystery I'm investigating still an open question, I cannot unreservedly trust Rhodes Island. However, in my days lodging here, I've witnessed physicians benevolent and adroit, warriors heroic and unyielding. Even if our beliefs differ, I still have considerable respect for your investments and efforts.
